svg.text: Top-down: how the app is built — read down by layer, across by component
VISITOR JOURNEY — how a visitor moves, left to right
no page writes its own fetch
Rule: Screens never call the API. Screens ask Services. Services call the API.
LAYER 2 · API — the only door from browser to data
LAYER 3 · DATA + ETL — where locations come from
Read it two ways: down the bands = layer by layer; across a band = component by component.
Detail follows: class diagram · component diagram · sequence diagram · page component view · page model · server page components.
